AdminMember.title: AdminMember
AdminMember.description: Authorized Google accounts allowed to manage participant datasets and lecture locations.

email.description: Lowercase Google email address of the authorized admin.

addedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

ActiveDatasetMeta.title: ActiveDatasetMeta
ActiveDatasetMeta.description: Admin-only metadata pointer for the currently published PPG UT participant Excel dataset.

isPublic.description: Whether the raw dataset is public (always false to protect PII).

revisionId.description: Active dataset revision identifier matching chunk documents.

fileName.description: Original Excel filename uploaded by admin.

availableSheets.description: List of worksheet names in the Excel workbook.

uploadedAt.description: ISO timestamp when admin uploaded the dataset.

uploadedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the uploading admin.

uploadedByEmail.description: Verified email of the uploading admin.

totalRows.description: Total number of participant rows across all chunks.

chunkCount.description: Total number of chunk documents for this revision.

matchedHeaders.description: Map of expected column keys to detected Excel headers.

missingRequiredHeaders.description: List of missing required column labels.

extraHeaders.description: List of extra Excel column headers.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last dataset update.

DatasetChunk.title: DatasetChunk
DatasetChunk.description: Admin-only batch of raw Excel participant rows belonging to a dataset revision.

isPublic.description: Whether the raw chunk is public (always false to protect PII).

revisionId.description: Revision ID that owns this chunk.

uploadedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the uploading admin.

rows.description: Compact array of raw participant rows.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was written.

LectureLocation.title: LectureLocation
LectureLocation.description: Manually managed lecture venue and address entry for PPG UT.

isPublic.description: Flag indicating location entry is publicly readable.

googleMapsUrl.description: Optional direct Google Maps link for the venue.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who created or updated this location.

LocationPageNote.title: LocationPageNote
LocationPageNote.description: Admin-managed announcement or note displayed above the lecture locations list.

isPublic.description: Flag indicating the note is publicly readable.

noteText.description: Sanitized HTML or text note content written by admin.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who updated the note.

updatedByEmail.description: Email of the admin who updated the note.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last note update.

PrivacyConfig.title: PrivacyConfig
PrivacyConfig.description: Publicly readable display privacy settings controlled by admin for User mode.

isPublic.description: Flag indicating privacy config is publicly readable by dashboard viewers.

maskPtkId.description: Whether PTK ID digits are partially masked in User mode.

maskAkunSimpkb.description: Whether Akun SIMPKB identifiers are partially masked in User mode.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who updated privacy config.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last privacy config update.

DatasetHistoryEntry.title: DatasetHistoryEntry
DatasetHistoryEntry.description: Compact snapshot summary saved when a dataset revision is published for wave comparison.

PublicAnalyticsMeta.title: PublicAnalyticsMeta
PublicAnalyticsMeta.description: Zero-PII public analytics pointer for User mode dashboards.

PublicAnalyticsChunk.title: PublicAnalyticsChunk
PublicAnalyticsChunk.description: Anonymized batch of demographic and placement attributes without PII.

PlacementLookup.title: PlacementLookup
PlacementLookup.description: SHA-256 keyed exact-match lookup entry with pre-masked participant identifiers.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Authorized admin accounts keyed by normalized email ID.

/datasets/{datasetId}.description: Admin-only singleton active dataset metadata document at /datasets/active.

/datasets/{datasetId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Admin-only raw participant row batches for a given dataset revision.

/public_analytics/{docId}.description: Zero-PII public analytics metadata pointer at /public_analytics/active.

/public_analytics/{docId}/chunks/{chunkI.description: Zero-PII anonymized participant attribute chunks for User mode charts and summaries.

/placement_lookup/{lookupId}.description: Exact-match SHA-256 hashed placement lookup records with masked PII.

/locations/{locationId}.description: Publicly readable lecture venues managed by admins.

/dataset_history/{historyId}.description: Admin-only historical dataset snapshots for period comparison.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Admin-only audit log of administrative actions.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Singleton public notes and privacy configuration documents (/settings/lokasi_note, /settings/privacy_config).
